aries.essence: Move-first, bold, direct energy. Most alive when there's a new challenge in front of you. Natural drive to start what doesn't yet exist — but interest can fade once it's up and running.
aries.inLove: As a partner, needs room to stay independent and prefers someone not easily threatened by the intensity. Romantic in pursuit mode; consistency takes conscious work.

taurus.essence: Slow, patient, sensual. Builds tangible foundations — money, comfort, home. Loves good routines and quality things. Hard to move once they've taken a position.
taurus.inLove: Loyal and physically present — affection via touch, food, calm togetherness. Watch for possessiveness when feeling insecure.

gemini.essence: Quick mind, wide curiosity, loves to talk. Easily bored if topic or person can't keep pace. Versatile — can do many things at once though sometimes nothing finishes.
gemini.inLove: Needs mental stimulation — a partner you can debate and laugh with. Emotional consistency is conscious work; not the auto-clingy type.

cancer.essence: Emotional, protective, memorial. Lives in the world of feeling — reads a mood shift before others notice. Rooted in family and home; a place that feels safe means everything.
cancer.inLove: Loves through caretaking — cooking, remembering small things, showing up on a hard day. Sensitive to rejection; needs a partner who doesn't frighten the soft parts.

leo.essence: Warm, proud, expressive. Most full when truly seen and appreciated. Generous with those close — has the gift of making people feel special. Crashes when feeling overlooked.
leo.inLove: Grand-gesture romantic; needs to be admired and seen as special. A partner who can appreciate without competing is a perfect fit.

virgo.essence: Analytical, practical, loves to fix and refine. Expresses love through small, well-aimed actions. Can get stuck overthinking detail; often feels not-enough even when the work is clean.
virgo.inLove: Acts-of-service love — meds when sick, remembered food allergies. Learning to accept the not-yet-perfect — including themselves — is the work.

libra.essence: Harmonious, aesthetic, relational. Most clearly themselves with a partner — not from weakness, but because partnership is the native mode. Watch for people-pleasing — own needs tend to land last.
libra.inLove: Classic romantic — quality time, beautiful settings, deep talks. Decision-making is hard; a partner clear about their own needs helps a lot.

scorpio.essence: Deep, intense, all-or-nothing. Lives at the emotional layers most people avoid. Fiercely loyal once you're inside the inner circle. Doesn't forget the feel of betrayal.
scorpio.inLove: Total commitment or nothing. Needs a partner brave enough for the hard truths. Jealousy can show up — trust work is the long lesson.

sagittarius.essence: Optimistic, exploratory, meaning-seeker. Needs freedom to move — physical, mental, philosophical. Honest enough to read as blunt; no harm meant, small talk just feels off.
sagittarius.inLove: A partner with their own full life — not one whose needs spill entirely into the relationship. Doesn't do feeling caged.

capricorn.essence: Strategic, persistent, long-game focus. Builds slowly but surely — the success celebrated at 40 tastes better than the one at 25. Can read as cold; really it's self-protective.
capricorn.inLove: Slow to open, but once committed — fully. A partner who sees the softness behind the work-wall is lucky for both sides.

aquarius.essence: Independent, experimental, caring at scale. Often feels different from those around them — not coincidence, the lens really is unconventional. Can seem emotionally cool while caring deeply.
aquarius.inLove: Friendship as the foundation. A partner who helps them commit without forcing convention is the right fit.

pisces.essence: Soft, intuitive, artistic. Lives in feeling and imagination — creative, spiritual, internal compass. Learning to limit absorption of other people's emotions is a lifelong lesson.
pisces.inLove: Romantic in the poetic sense — sees a partner at their best version. Needs a partner who helps hold the boundaries, not one who exploits the softness.
